title: Pilots report UAPs emerging from the Dipper

tellings.quote: Even Navy pilot Ryan Graves, who's very humble in his claims, has said that pilots reported UAPs emerging from the Dipper and even dog fighting near it in orbit.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a former Navy pilot named Ryan Graves, whom he calls careful about his claims, has said that pilots reported UAPs, meaning unidentified anomalous phenomena or unexplained objects, coming out of something called the Dipper. According to Michels, the pilots also described these objects dogfighting near it in orbit, in the 2010s. If true, it would mean unknown craft were active high above the Earth and seen by military pilots.
